name: empty
useFor: Use when a list, search or panel has nothing to show. Put it inside a Window (or use EmptyState) when it stands for a whole list. Give it EmptyMedia with variant icon and a lucide glyph, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription and one action in EmptyContent.
constraints: An empty state without a way forward
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (empty-state.tsx body, the merchant tiles in features.tsx)
title: Empty
description: A quiet centered message for an empty list: an optional merchant-tile mark, a display-face title, one muted line and the next action.
